outcome: Multi-label data reaches a separate concrete evaluator without duplicating the shared artifact/admission backbone.

artifacts.purpose: Multi-label conversion and shared alignment reuse

interfaces: LabelSet is a private sorted unique vector; reject duplicate submitted labels before set construction.
LabelMarginals is distinct from categorical distribution; exact vocabulary, finite [0,1], no sum-normalization.
MultiLabelOutput supports Outcome<LabelSet> and marginals, not scoring confidence; retained confidence observations remain legal.
acceptance_criteria: Empty set is answered; abstention, missing row and missing marginal key remain distinct.
Reject task/target/probability/policy mismatches, scored_choice sources, top-level confidence, counts, partial labels/per-label abstention.
Private checked structures and evaluator signatures prevent passing categorical policies or foreign-dataset indexes.

verification.expected: Duplicate sets and unsupported shapes fail; [0.9,0.8] marginals remain unchanged.
No inferred task kinds or cross-kind coercion.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
Saved response records exact input/source/output hashes, commands, exit codes, expected/actual results, and unresolved failures.
New or changed-authority artifacts are indexed; operational state is updated in Fizzy after acceptance.
